from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record for one judgment document that may contain 渎职罪 (dereliction of duty) case information"""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., '刑事申诉驳回通知书', '民事二审判决书', '行政二审裁定书', etc.)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The stated cause of action in the judgment (e.g., '玩忽职守罪', '不动产登记纠纷', '婚约财产纠纷', etc.)")
    is_dereliction_of_duty_case: bool = Field(description="Whether this judgment involves a 渎职罪 (dereliction of duty) crime")
    judgment_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or case name of this judgment document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentRecord]
